properties.name: Downtown
properties.info: The Financial District, SoMa and the hills above them: Nob Hill, Russian Hill, North Beach and Chinatown, out to Mission Bay and Treasure Island.

properties.name: Northside
properties.info: Along the Bay from the Marina to the Presidio, and the Western Addition, Japantown and Pacific Heights behind it.

properties.name: West Side
properties.info: The Richmond and the Sunset, either side of Golden Gate Park, out to Ocean Beach and Lake Merced.

properties.name: Central
properties.info: The middle of the city: the Mission, the Castro, Noe Valley, the Haight and Twin Peaks.

properties.name: Southeast
properties.info: Potrero Hill and Bernal Heights down to Bayview, the Excelsior and Visitacion Valley.
